name: DIET 3272
title: Food Service Systems Management I
description: (Also offered as NUSC 3272.) Quantity food procurement, preparation and distribution; recipe standardization and menu development; sanitation and safety; portion and quality control; systems approach and delivery systems.
requirement_description: Open only to junior or higher Dietetics and Nutritional Science majors, others with instructor consent. Recommended preparation: NUSC 3233, 3234. Not open to students who have passed NUSC 3270.
